newsitem.title: USA: Dow barrels to yet another record high.
newsitem.headline: Dow barrels to yet another record high.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial barreled to its second straight record high close on Wednesday, moving further above the 8,000-point level after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan painted a near-perfect picture of the economy.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 26.71 points at a new high of 8,088.36, one day after soaring 155 points.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 17-11 on active volume of 621 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
